programmes.amount_note: 'The maximum possible grant amounts to EUR 100,000' with the gender bonus; otherwise EUR 89,000. Funding rate is 80% of eligible costs (10% equity from shareholders, 10% from other defined monetary sources); with the gender bonus 90% (5% equity, 5% other sources).
programmes.deadline_note: Ongoing submission with several decision dates per year.

procedure_steps.detail: Check the target group: start-up teams before incorporation, or companies registered in the Commercial Register no more than 6 months ago (micro and small enterprises).
Prepare the project and financing plan showing the required equity and other own contributions.
Submit through the aws Fördermanager; applications are decided at one of several decision dates per year.

documents_required.doc: Financing plan evidencing the equity contribution by shareholders

eligibility.other_note: Applicants may be 'natural persons (start-up teams before the company is established)' or companies within 6 months of Commercial Register registration; also 'already established independent partnerships or corporations (limited to micro and small enterprises according to the SME definition)'. A gender bonus raises the rate and ceiling. De minimis is not stated on the page.

programmes.source_snippet: The maximum possible grant amounts to EUR 100,000 ... 80 % of eligible costs, with 10 % to be contributed as equity by shareholders ... max. 6 months after their registration in the Commercial Register ... Ongoing; several decision dates per year.

programmes.amount_note: For 2026 the maximum funding per project is EUR 3,000,000. Funding is a mix of grant and loan; the FFG page states support of up to 70% of project costs for startups plus a 5% bonus for high-tech startups, and loan repayment falls due five years after project completion.
programmes.deadline_note: Applications can be submitted at any time; the 2026 call runs from 1 January to 31 December 2026.

procedure_steps.detail: Scope an R&D project with high commercial potential, running through to prototype stage.
Prepare the project description, work packages and cost plan (cooperation with partners is possible).
Submit at any time via the FFG eCall portal; FFG evaluates and offers a grant/loan mix.

documents_required.doc: Project description with work packages and milestones (eCall)

eligibility.other_note: Open to 'all company sizes - including startups (companies in formation)'. Projects must show high commercial potential and technical sophistication.

programmes.source_snippet: Anträge innovativer und wettbewerbsfähiger Unternehmen können laufend eingereicht werden (Kooperation möglich); Call 2026: 01.01.2026 - 31.12.2026; max. Förderung pro Projekt EUR 3.000.000.
